_doc: Phase 3c touch layout (input/joystick.ts, ui/touch.ts). joystick: fixed base at the bottom left (left / bottom offsets in px from the safe area), base radius and knob radius in px; the hit circle is radius + hitPadding (a thumb anywhere on or near it grabs the stick, no aiming). actions: the receiver / action cluster at the bottom right (right / bottom offsets, square size in px, never scaled down). minClearance: px the stick's hit area keeps from the cluster (tests/joystick.test.ts).
